capabilities.description: Tightly-coupled N-robot parameterized trajectory following with 20 Hz sparse-neighbor consensus, transitive gossip barriers, dual-tier peer watchdog, and <50 ms ESTOP flooding.

attributes.name: sync-topology
attributes.description: Peer graph coupling topology supported by the local sync provider.

attributes.name: max-linear-speed-mps
attributes.description: Hard ceiling on commanded forward linear velocity in meters per second.

capabilities.description: Large-scale shared-wall-clock trajectory playback triggered at UTC T0 with Fail-Closed Chrony/PTP offset gating and single-robot fault isolation.

attributes.name: sync-mode
attributes.description: Time synchronization mechanism used to trigger playback.

attributes.name: max-clock-offset-ms
attributes.description: Maximum allowed local wall-clock offset before Fail-Closed rejection.

operations.description: Execute a closed-loop multi-robot synchronized path along a roboguide.sync-track/v1 track spec.

parameters.name: track_spec_json
parameters.description: Serialized JSON string conforming to roboguide.sync-track/v1.

parameters.name: neighbors_json
parameters.description: Serialized JSON array of sparse graph neighbor endpoints and weights.

parameters.name: sync_params_json
parameters.description: Optional serialized JSON object overriding consensus gain, barrier timeout, or watchdog thresholds.

parameters.name: context_id
parameters.description: Logical context identifier shared across the synchronized peer channel.

parameters.name: context_role_id
parameters.description: Role identifier of this robot within the coordination group.

operations.description: Play a time-indexed roboguide.choreography/v1 trajectory triggered at shared UTC T0.

parameters.name: choreography_spec_json
parameters.description: Serialized JSON string conforming to roboguide.choreography/v1.

parameters.name: t0_utc_ms
parameters.description: Shared UNIX epoch trigger timestamp in milliseconds.

parameters.name: max_clock_offset_ms
parameters.description: Fail-Closed clock offset ceiling in milliseconds.
